content.body:
Recruit a player to your squad; recruiter level and above. /recruit <player>
Accept an invitation to join a squad. /accept
Decline an invitation to join a squad; times out after a while. /decline
Leave your current squad. /leave
Disband your squad; CO's only. /disband
Remove a player from the squad; XO level and above. /remove <player>
Promote a player up one level up to 1 level below yours; XO and above. /promote <player>
Demote a player; limited to players below your level; XO and above. /demote <player>
Resign your command; demotes you to XO and makes <player> the CO. /resign <player>
